'''evol34 Hunt Down-Dark Side''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[evol34]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD evol34 DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The objective os this combo is to win duels, is also very competent in battles

== Strategy ==

Is very simple, try to make as many as possible duels between Vader and luke and Obi-Wan, also try to get Luke to the Dark Side.
